events.name: stall_frontend
events.desc: Cycles stalled waiting on the frontend (instruction cache, branch resteer)

events.name: stall_backend
events.desc: Cycles stalled waiting on the backend (memory, execution latency)

events.name: load_inst
events.desc: Load instructions retired, including vector loads

events.name: fp_vector_inst
events.desc: Scalar floating-point and vector arithmetic instructions retired

events.name: fp_vector_uop
events.desc: Floating-point and vector micro-operations; a VLEN-wide vector instruction counts as several

events.name: l2_access
events.desc: L2 cache accesses caused by L1 data cache refills

metrics.name: branch_mispredict_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of retired branches that were mispredicted

metrics.name: l1d_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of L1 data cache reads that missed

metrics.name: l1i_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of L1 instruction cache reads that missed

metrics.name: vector_uops_per_inst
metrics.desc: Average micro-operations per floating-point or vector instruction

metrics.name: retiring
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by instructions that retired

metrics.name: bad_speculation
metrics.desc: Issue slots lost to mispredicted branches

metrics.name: fe_bound
metrics.desc: Issue slots lost because the frontend did not supply the backend
metrics.formula: max(0, 1 - retiring - bad_speculation) * stall_frontend / max(1, stall_frontend + stall_backend)

metrics.name: be_bound
metrics.desc: Issue slots lost because the backend could not accept more work. A100 exposes no L2 miss or dTLB event, so a data-cache miss cannot be costed and this is not broken down further; use l1d_miss_rate to judge whether memory is the cause
metrics.formula: max(0, 1 - retiring - bad_speculation) * stall_backend / max(1, stall_frontend + stall_backend)

metrics.name: fe_bound.icache
metrics.desc: Frontend stalls attributable to instruction cache misses

metrics.name: fe_bound.other
metrics.desc: Frontend stalls from fetch and decode throughput rather than misses
